Both of these compounds are linked to Fatty-acid amide hydrolase 1, indicating a possible pathway where Populoside B may influence the activity of this enzyme through its interaction with Phosphatidylserine synthase 1. The consistent scores across the two paths suggest a robust relationship, though the exact mechanism by which Populoside B affects Fatty-acid amide hydrolase 1 remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a potential regulatory role for Populoside B in the context of this enzyme, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
